gizmo.title: Step by Step
gizmo.description: Reveals one section of content each time the Continue button is pressed. Every step can hold any HAX block (heading, paragraph, multiple choice, video) and can be duplicated right from the editor.

configure.title: Continue Button Label
configure.description: Text for the main button that advances the content

configure.title: Show All Label
configure.description: Text for the dropdown option that reveals every step

configure.title: Initially Visible Content
configure.description: Number of content sections visible at the start (default 1)

configure.title: Confetti Effect
configure.description: Fire confetti when the pause button is clicked

advanced.title: Show Control Buttons
advanced.description: Turn the split pause controls on or off
